name: comparison-incomplete-a-headerless-journal-yields-a-bound
description: Readable entries with no header. This once refused the whole file; it yields a BOUND instead, with the absence reported without a line number because an absence does not have one. The entries are self-describing evidence that heads were accepted, and what was lost — the protocol and wire versions those record hashes derive under — is exactly the kind of loss a lower bound is for. Refusing here would be a verdict where a bound will do.
